method: Read-only source/regression review and mental eight-stranger play-through; no tests, browser, git or runtime edits.
context: Parent reports source restoration and runtime CI green; this reviewer did not execute or independently rerun CI.

requestedScenarios.result: Near-TV players receive shape pads and own-team discussion; stage/remote players receive prompt/options plus their local clock; late or permanently departed players receive a read-only public stage. Fixed teams are seeded and balanced at init.

First canonical stamped answer is immutable. The player can resend the same pending choice until confirmation; everybody remains in the shared phase until its reading hold or deadline. Opposite choices leave TV/non-owner/spectator views equal before reveal.
SDK pause rejects game inputs/timers. Resume shifts the fixed speed end and reading end while preserving the answer stamp. Frozen group reveal cuts shift uniformly; presence cannot recalculate them.
Accepted picks remain in aggregate progress/scoring. An unanswered absent seat leaves the denominator; returning eligible seats restore the original pending answer window when necessary.

Fixed membership and banked team scoring remain; accepted choices cannot be erased. A permanent return stays nonparticipating, sees the current public stage and cannot revise or submit another choice.

Every unpaused group phase has a finite deadline. Reveal and occupied podium tiers traverse automatically without a VIP Next tap. Host VIP reassignment/authentication, especially loss during a paused phase, is a shell integration boundary not reproduced in this source-only review.

SDK majorityPick selects only among tied aggregate choices with state RNG, without the answer key. Closed tie copy explicitly describes random selection. Private vote and shared correctness remain distinct.
Correctness, speed and capped streaks can close a reachable gap. There is no handicap; an insurmountable lead cannot be caught. README says this explicitly rather than promising a universal comeback.

Final reveal publishes shared correctness/own vote but omits final team rows, score chips, rank and numeric shared gain. The single occupied first-place tier then unveils the room score; done supplies the complete shared board and no individual awards.

remainingWeaknesses.weakness: No observed live eight-stranger session establishes comprehension, delivered audio, network recovery or shell VIP transfer. Reducer/SSR evidence cannot replace that experience.

An uncatchable team lead can reduce late-game stakes. The README truthfully retains discussion/questions for everyone, but continued enjoyment cannot be inferred from correct scoring. Adding rubber-band points would change the documented rules.

Presence-dependent averaging takes a first-timer a second reading: an unanswered absent seat leaves the mean, while an accepted departed pick stays. Intro and beside-TV receipt explain averaging; compact staged receipts prioritize personal/shared gains rather than repeating the full eligibility sentence.

Pathological legal text remains dense, particularly crossed-out unbroken alternatives, and the required reading floor makes wordy custom rounds slower. This is not lost text or an incorrect timer; concise authored packs are the practical mitigation.
Room podium still draws empty second/third plinths beside its one shared first-place entry. No nonexistent competitor is named, no future identity is leaked, and the cooperative result is truthful.

regressionEvidenceRead: group-server.test.ts: fixed teams, stamps, pause, denominator/retained answers, room plurality/mean/streak, privacy and result ranks
group-retained-progress.test.tsx: both group modes across TV/staged/remote/spectator, presence lifecycle, real reveal scoring, next-question clearing and unchanged individual counters
group-reveal-sequence.test.tsx: boundaries, mixed roles, pause/resume, early all-answered privacy, VIP Next and final automatic podium
group-reveal-cut-stability.test.ts: frozen scored cuts under leave/reconnect and pause
group-final-room-privacy.test.tsx: final shared gain/total/rank omission and truthful nonfinal fields
group-room-tie.test.tsx and group-room-tie-pacing.test.ts: real seeded ties, one public cue per surface and translated reading budget
group-pacing.test.ts: final usable VIP window and timer-only completion
group-properties.test.ts: mixed canSeeTv roles, frozen deterministic lifecycle replay, secret omissions and bounded finite terminal traversal
group-screens.test.tsx: discussion identity, read-only observers, truthful personal/shared receipts and podium tiers
vip.test.ts and next-button.test.ts: inherited SDK pause/skip/end and Next behavior
conclusion: No concrete material defect or necessary runtime change identified. The documented party behavior is coherent under the requested mental trace. Remaining gains are presentation refinements or evidence expansion; this is not a claim of live-human or original-audio convergence.
